newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end steady in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end steady in calm trading.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed little changed in low-volume trading kept quiet by the U.S. Columbus Day holiday and a lack of follow-through buying after the recent run-up in prices, dealers said.
"You could already see on Friday there were not many buyers in the market, and this continued today," one dealer said.
Several investors expect a correction to bring prices down, but players who missed the rally are waiting to buy at lower levels, traders said.
Only 735 contracts changed hands in the Conf government bond futures. The December Conf rose three basis points to 115.21.
The average yield on government bonds rose one point to 3.65 percent. Grey market prices were little changed to easier.
Two-year and five-year Swiss franc swaps were off three ticks to 2.07/15 and 3.25/33 percent. Ten-year swaps fell two points to 4.17/25.
